summary: Comprehensive testing of P0 Photo Upload Bug Fix, Login Page Redesign, Dashboard, and Sidebar Navigation. The critical photo upload bug has been FIXED. All 14 backend upload API tests passed. Frontend photo upload component working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: ContainerPhotoUpload.js: Well-implemented state machine with EMPTY, UPLOADING, SUCCESS, ERROR states to handle race conditions
Minor: ESLint warnings about missing dependencies in useEffect hooks across multiple pages (AuthContext, BillingPage, EditMovementPage, etc.) - not breaking but should be addressed

passed_tests.feature: P0 Bug Fix - Photo Upload Display
passed_tests.notes: Photos are correctly loaded and displayed in edit movement page. All 4 photo slots (Frente, Traseira, Lado Esquerdo, Lado Direito) show uploaded images.

Table displays recent movements with Date/Time, Type, Container, Driver, Status columns

passed_tests.feature: New Movement Page - Photo Upload Component

Existing photos load correctly from /api/uploads/. Counter shows '4 de 4 fotos adicionadas'
Zoom (preview) and Remove (X) buttons appear on hover over photos
Upload endpoint accepts JPG, PNG, WebP files up to 10MB

context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 photo upload bug is FIXED. ContainerPhotoUpload.js was rewritten with distinct states (EMPTY, UPLOADING, SUCCESS, ERROR) for each slot. Photos are stored at /api/uploads/{filename} and served via StaticFiles. Backend tests in test_upload_api.py (14 tests, all passing). Movement ID 280f3649-1538-482a-a6c7-2e7391a4a89f has all 4 photos for reference testing.
rca_of_the_issue: The previous photo upload bug was caused by race conditions in state management. The component was incorrectly sharing state between photo slots, causing display issues. The fix implemented a proper state machine with distinct states (EMPTY, UPLOADING, SUCCESS, ERROR) for each photo position, with proper cleanup of blob URLs and isolated state updates.
